# Ls038 — Instance ID `#0` or out-of-range / overflowing

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

**Section**: §12.1c (`12-1c-syntax`)  
**Fixture**: [`step-examples/12-1c-syntax/Ls038.stp`](../../step-examples/12-1c-syntax/Ls038.stp)  

## Sources
- T016, T017, A022

## Description

ISO 10303-21 requires positive non-zero instance IDs. `#0` is invalid. Very large IDs (≥20 digits) overflow `uint64_t` accumulators; wrap-around may collide with low-numbered IDs and enable type confusion. stepcode sometimes skips an entire section when ID width exceeds its allocator's `digits10 + 1`.

## Reproducer recipe

`#0=IFCPERSON($,$,'',$,$,$,$,$);`, `#9999999999999999999999=IFCPERSON(...);`, `#18446744073709551617=AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D(...);`

## Expected kernel behavior

Reject `#0`; detect overflow during digit accumulation and reject with `E_INSTANCE_ID_RANGE`; if width must be capped, emit precise per-instance diagnostic and continue.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject, warn-and-proceed`
